title: Scam Awareness 101 & Basic Review
objectives: Spot the top 4 token scam vectors on Solana: Honeypots, Freeze Authority, Mint Traps, and Liquidity Pulls
Inspect on-chain token authorities before swapping
Consolidate core Tier 1 skills before advancing to intermediate liquidity labs

steps.title: The Dark Side of Permissionless Finance
steps.body:
Because anyone can deploy a token and pool on Solana in seconds, scammers have a near-infinite supply of fresh traps. Their weapon is not a server hack or a stolen password - it is *your* ignorance of on-chain parameters. They count on beginners who never read the fine print.

Learning how to identify malicious token contracts is the single most valuable protective skill in Web3. Everything a token can do to you - freeze your balance, print infinite supply, drain the pool - is written in **public** account data you can inspect in seconds.

**The mindset shift:** stop asking *'is this token a good investment?'* and start asking *'what is this token allowed to do to me?'* The second question has an objectively correct, on-chain answer.

steps.title: The 4 Essential Solana Red Flags
steps.body:
Before buying any newly launched token, verify these 4 parameters on a block explorer:

1. **Freeze Authority:** If not revoked (`None`), the creator can freeze your token account so you can never sell or transfer!
2. **Mint Authority:** If not revoked (`None`), the creator can print billions of new tokens at zero cost and dump them into the pool.
3. **LP Token Burn / Lock:** If the creator still owns 100% of the pool's LP tokens, they can withdraw all SOL at any moment (Classic Rug Pull).
4. **Holder Concentration:** If the top 5 non-pool wallets hold 70%+ of the supply, insider dumping is inevitable.

steps.title: Under the Hood: Checking Authorities in Solana CLI
steps.body: In the SPL Token standard, authorities are stored in the token Mint account state: `spl-token authorize <MINT_ADDRESS> mint --disable` and `spl-token authorize <MINT_ADDRESS> freeze --disable`. A legitimate token project explicitly executes these two commands upon launch to cryptographically guarantee no more tokens can be minted or frozen.

questions.prompt: You inspect a new token on Solana Explorer and see 'Freeze Authority: Active (Creator Wallet)'. What does this mean?
options: Your funds earn daily staking yield
The creator has the cryptographic power to block your wallet from selling or transferring tokens
The transaction fee is locked at 0.000005 SOL
questions.explainRight: Spot on! An active freeze authority allows the creator to blacklist wallets at will, a massive scam indicator.
questions.explainWrong: Incorrect. Active Freeze Authority gives the creator permission to freeze token accounts, preventing sales.

questions.prompt: What must a creator do to prove they cannot mint infinite new tokens and dilute holders?
options: Post a verification badge on X / Twitter
Permanently revoke (set to None) the Mint Authority on-chain
questions.explainRight: Correct! Setting the Mint Authority to null/None cryptographically locks the maximum supply forever.
questions.explainWrong: Incorrect. Only revoking the on-chain Mint Authority guarantees supply cannot be inflated.
